text.text_excerpt: This place is a really quaint neighborhood bar. Tuesday is steak night...went tonight with some friends. Steak n potatos r always very flavorful. They give u a huge glass of wine for really cheap...mind u it's not top shelf wine but it does the trick. Good food n drinks and a great music= a good time. They also have pool tables. Waitress was very helpful and friendly!

I had a lot going on a Tuesday Night. I needed to get out the house. I knew I wanted a drink but I didn't want to go too Far from New Orleans East so I drove around on Downman street and saw a parking lot full of cars! I saw it was a bar named Gabby's So I immediately pulled into the parking lot and saw the big steak night tuesday night! There's also line dancing that goes on with groups on certain nights. I ordered a Rum punch which was 8 dollars! My steak though! That was a pretty good dawg gon steak. I had got a nice sized steak and garlic potatoes for about $16 bucks. That was the special for Wednesday Night. I am unsure the specials for any other night but I definitely know when i wa...

Amazing food always! Tuesday is steak night and you won't be disappointed! The staff are totally professional and amazing! There is a line dancing class Tuesday night (I believe) and people there are friendly. Cozy place with good atmosphere
